INSERT INTO chinmay_astro.messages (
  user_id,
  consultation_id,
  direction,
  message_type,
  content,
  whatsapp_message_id,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

=INSERT INTO chinmay_astro.message_log (
  user_id,
  phone_number,
  direction,
  message_type,
  message_content,
  whatsapp_message_id,
  status,
  error_message
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.userId ? $json.userId : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.phoneNumber }}',
  '{{ $json.direction }}',
  '{{ $json.messageType }}',
  '{{ $json.messageContent.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.whatsappMessageId ? "'" + $json.whatsappMessageId + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  {{ $json.errorMessage ? "'" + $json.errorMessage.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }}
)
RETURNING id

INSERT INTO chinmay_astro.messages (
  user_id,
  consultation_id,
  direction,
  message_type,
  content,
  whatsapp_message_id,
  metadata,
  created_at
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  $7::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;
